admission.justification: Role matrix and containment checks prevent worker authority escalation or a manager starting work under another master.

exclusions: Developer dashboard selection is not an agent may-start-table call.
statement: Who may start what is decided from the caller's binding: an architect may start every role except architect; an orchestrator manager, worker, reviewer and curator, only on selections under its own sprint; a manager worker, reviewer and curator, only on selections under its own master and sprint; worker, reviewer, curator and system-specialist start none; anything else is refused with the rule in words.
